Level by Level at a Glance

What you gain and when. Full details are under Class Abilities.

LvlYou gain

Class Abilities

1st Level

Firearm Proficiency

  • Effect: Use blackpowder weapons without disadvantage.
  • Firearm damage is exploding: when a damage die shows its highest number, roll it again and add the result (see Exploding Dice in the Codex).
  • Non-Gunslingers follow the Firearms training rules in the Codex

Quick Draw

  • Effect: Drawing a loaded sidearm (pistol) doesn't use your one free object use this turn.
  • The weapon must already be loaded
  • Drawing an unloaded weapon and loading it still costs a full action

Dead Eye

  • Effect: Gain advantage on your first ranged attack roll each round, on a turn in which you do not move.
  • You cannot move before or after attacking: once you attack with Dead Eye you are rooted until the end of your turn, and if you have already moved this turn you gain no benefit. Forced movement (being shoved, knocked prone and so on) does not count

Grit

  • Effect: Once per day, when reduced to 0 HP or below, make a Fortitude save, DC = 10 + damage taken above 0 HP. On a success, remain at 1 HP and stay conscious.
  • Gains a second use per day at 10th level
  • Gains a third use per day at 20th level

2nd Level

Lightning Reload

  • Effect: All blackpowder weapons reload one round faster (minimum: reload as part of an attack, once per round).
  • Combined with Quick Draw, a Gunslinger can draw, fire, and reload in a single round, ready to fire again next round

3rd Level

Dead Aim

  • Effect: Spend 2 rounds aiming without moving — full concentration, no other actions. The next shot this combat gains advantage and deals +1d6 bonus damage.
  • If interrupted while aiming, the bonus is lost but the rounds are not wasted

4th Level

Called Shot

  • Effect: Declare before rolling, and take Disadvantage on the attack roll to aim for a specific location. Only one shot a round can be a called shot, and its save is against your Class Save DC.
  • Head: on hit, target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC, or is stunned 1 round. A creature that recovers from your Head shot is also immune to your Head shots for the rest of the encounter
  • Arm: on hit, target makes Fortitude save or drops what they're holding
  • Leg: on hit, target's movement is halved for 1 round (Fortitude save to avoid)
  • At 10th level: Called Shot no longer requires disadvantage — the Gunslinger places shots precisely without compromising accuracy

5th Level

Steady Shot

  • Effect: While Dead Eye applies, the first attack that hits each round deals +1d6 bonus damage (+2d6 at 10th level, +3d6 at 15th level).
  • Stacks with Dead Aim; both bonuses are added on the same shot

6th Level

Perfect Shot

  • Effect: Once per day, declare before rolling. The next ranged attack deals maximum damage regardless of the dice result.
  • The attack still requires a hit. A die set to its maximum by this ability does not explode; only a rolled maximum explodes.

7th Level

Extra Attack

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex). A firearm still has to be loaded for each shot.

8th Level

Trick Shot (Dexterity)

  • Effect: Perform an impossible-looking shot — DC determined by the GM based on difficulty, using the General Difficulty Tiers table.
  • Shoot around corners, ricochet off surfaces, disarm a target at range within 30ft
  • Pin clothing or hair to a surface, cut a rope, thread a needle
  • One attempt per round — a failed check simply misses

9th Level

Brace and Fire

  • Effect: Once per round, out of turn, stand firm against a charging creature: fire before they reach you without needing Dead Eye's no-movement requirement.
  • If the attack hits, the charging creature takes damage and must make a Fortitude save or stop the charge

10th Level

  • Point Blank: no disadvantage on ranged attacks made within 5ft of an enemy

13th Level

Dead Aim (Improved)

  • Effect: Dead Aim's bonus damage rises to +2d6.

15th Level

  • Dexterity Bonus: permanent +1 Dexterity

20th Level

Perfect Shot (Improved)

  • Effect: Perfect Shot can be used twice per day.

24th Level

Legendary Shot

  • Effect: Once per encounter, make a single ranged attack against any target in line of sight regardless of range — no distance penalties apply.
  • Any creature that witnesses the shot and survives must make a Will save against your Class Save DC, or suffer disadvantage on their first attack against the Gunslinger for the remainder of the encounter

Kits: Gunslinger Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Gunslinger folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation. Your kit defines the tradition, culture, and context that shaped your relationship with blackpowder.
